raw_text: Graphika Report: Network of AI-Generated News Anchors Used for Anti-India Information Operation. Graphika has identified a network of YouTube channels and social media pages using HeyGen-style AI-generated news anchors to broadcast fabricated anti-India news bulletins. The synthetic anchors present false narratives about economic collapse, internal unrest, and political instability. Infrastructure analysis traces hosting to servers in Islamabad and Shenzhen. The operation represents a significant evolution in synthetic media-driven information warfare.
